3. **P1 — Another lease can extend a session past its own expiry.**  
   [endpoint_lease_manager.ex:253](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/mcp/endpoint_lease_manager.ex:253)

   Acquisition extends the shared generation expiry. Tokens contain no individual expiry. A short lease’s token remained dispatchable after expiry when another acquisition supplied a longer lease. Session event delivery and its periodic checks use this shared state.

   **Correction:** Put the individual lease expiry in each token. Check both token expiry and generation state. Existing renewal tests check the renewed token, but not the expired original token.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
title: Another lease can extend a session past its own expiry
